description.blurb: S/2003 J 10 was discovered in February 2003 at the Mauna Kea Observatory in Hawaii.
description.more: S/2003 J 10 has a mean radius of less than a mile, or about one kilometer. At a mean distance of about 14 million miles (23 million kilometers) from Jupiter, the satellite takes about 716 Earth days to complete one orbit. S/2003 J10 was so designated because it is a satellite (S) that was discovered in 2003, and was the 10th satellite of Jupiter (J) to be found that year.
